# Tensorcraft

> Interactive, story-driven ML education for frontend engineers. Learn browser-based machine learning through JavaScript, TypeScript, and tools you already know.

## What is Tensorcraft?

Tensorcraft is a web application that teaches machine learning to frontend developers. It uses a unique "bridge" methodology — mapping familiar frontend concepts (like useState, Array.map, fetch) to their ML equivalents (model weights, tensor ops, inference API). Each course is a themed narrative where learners build real ML models that run entirely in the browser using TensorFlow.js.

## Key Facts

- 5 themed courses, each with 11 modules and 55 lessons (~22 hours per theme)
- 275 total lessons across all themes
- 295 interactive coding exercises with in-browser Sandpack editor
- 50+ Frontend-to-ML concept bridges
- Per-theme one-time purchase: $59 (single theme), $99 (2 themes), $129 (3 themes), $159 (all 5)
- Module 1 of every theme is free — no account required
- Dark mode only, WCAG 2.1 AA compliant
- Built with Next.js 15, TensorFlow.js, Supabase, Stripe

## The 5 Themes

1. Deep Orbit (Space) — Time-Series & Signals — Build a deep-space signal classifier with RNNs/LSTMs
2. Neon Protocol (Cyberpunk) — Computer Vision — Build an urban anomaly detector with CNNs
3. Signal Ward (Medical) — NLP & Text Intelligence — Build a clinical text assistant with transformers
4. Nova Canvas (Creative AI) — Multimodal & Generative — Build a creative assistant with GANs/diffusion
5. Terra Grid (Industrial) — Edge AI & Production ML — Build an edge monitoring system with MLOps

## Who It's For

Frontend developers (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, vanilla JS) who want to add machine learning to their skillset without switching to Python. Each bridge analogy maps a JS/TS concept to its ML equivalent.
